Method of Attack: Ransomware attacks targeting healthcare and first responder networks
Custom-tailored ransom demands up to $25 million
Use of VOIP and encrypted email services to contact victims if ransom not paid within eight days
Impacted Systems: First responder networks including law enforcement agencies, emergency medical services, 9-1-1 dispatch centers, municipalities
Indicators of Compromise: 700 GB of data stolen from HSE network
Use of VOIP and encrypted email for victim contact
TLP:WHITE flash alert issued by FBI
